name: Deathstalker Lesh
summary: At Southpoint Tower, Deathstalker Lesh watches the human farms in the Hillsbrad Foothills. She serves High Executor Darthalia and gauges when the Forsaken should strike.

sections.title: Eyes on the Fields
sections.body: From Southpoint Tower, Deathstalker Lesh watches the human farmers and town militia in the nearby Hillsbrad Fields. The tower stands on the southern road through the Hillsbrad Foothills. Lesh belongs to the Deathstalkers, the Forsaken's covert network of scouts, spies, and assassins. She tracks enemy movements and numbers for High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill. When the moment is right, Lesh sends Darthalia a coded message: “The raven's cry from the west doth beckon.” The words signal that Hillsbrad is ripe for the Forsaken's attack.

faq.answer: Lesh is a Forsaken scout at Southpoint Tower. She answers to High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill and watches human activity across the Hillsbrad Fields.
The Deathstalkers serve Queen Sylvanas Windrunner as scouts, spies, and assassins. They gather intelligence for the Forsaken military and eliminate high-value targets across Lordaeron.

faq.q: What is Lesh's role at Southpoint Tower?
faq.answer: Lesh keeps watch from Southpoint Tower, surveying both the Hillsbrad Fields and the town of Hillsbrad. When the moment is right, she sends a traveler to High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill with a coded message signaling that Hillsbrad is ripe for attack.
Lesh reports to High Executor Darthalia, the Forsaken commander at Tarren Mill who oversees the offensive against the human forces in Hillsbrad.

angles.text: For you as Forsaken, scouts like Lesh help secure Lordaeron from Alliance resurgents.
As a rogue, you share the covert work Deathstalker Lesh performs for the Horde's war effort.
